headline: British Royal Mint Reports Record Silver and Platinum Sales Amid Inflation
summary: The British Royal Mint announced record year-to-date silver and platinum sales alongside renewed gold demand despite higher prices and rising bond yields.
why: Precious metals sales figures reflect broader retail and institutional investor sentiment toward hedging against inflation and macroeconomic volatility.

impacts.name: Silver and Platinum
impacts.why: Record sales figures reflect strong retail and institutional investor demand for precious metals.
